errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The account sent too many requests of this kind recently. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. Record writes, reads and blob uploads are counted separately.

errors.name: ServerBusy
errors.description: The server is already moving as many files as it can hold. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. It isn't counted against the account.
